english.note: This is the all-purpose term for an independent examination of financial records, controls, and procedures.

examples.english: The company hired outside accountants to conduct an audit this year to make sure the accounts were in order.
examples.traditional: 公司今年請外間會計師做審計，確保賬目冇問題。
